in_hebrew.name: איסולת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Isolt is derived from the Old English word ‘isol’, meaning ‘ice’ or ‘coldness’. In the Hebrew language, it can be transliterated as ‘איסולת’ (Isult), which carries the meaning of ‘ice’ or ‘coldness’. In a metaphorical sense, this name could also refer to someone who lives in solitude or isolation.

in_greek.name: Ισόλτη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Isolt in Greek is transliterated as ‘Ισόλτη’ (Isolt), which means ‘isolated one’. This name can be derived from the Greek word ‘ισός’ (isos), meaning ‘equal’ or ‘same’, and ‘λήθη’ (lēthē), meaning ‘forgetfulness’ or ‘oblivion’. Together, these meanings can signify a person who is separate or set apart from others, or someone who is forgotten or overlooked.

in_latin.name: Isult
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Isolt is ‘Isult’. It is derived from the Old English word ‘isol’, meaning ‘ice’ or ‘coldness’. This name may also be associated with the Latin word ‘isulus’, which means ‘iceberg’ or ‘icy mountain’.
